videos.title: MM junk removal Pricing
videos.description:
For an estimate, picture a Chevy, Ford, or Dodge pickup truck, and consider if everything will fit in one load.  Dump fees, labor, gas, and all are typically around $185 per load, with a minimum charge of $95. If you estimate two, maybe three loads, expect around $370-$550.
For big jobs we dispatch a commercial size truck. Larger trucks hold up to 6 pickup loads at once costing $900 to $1295 on average, depending on weight.
Mattress, box-springs, TVs, tires, propane tanks, fluorescent bulbs, fridges and Hazardous waste incurs extra charges.


To get a quote, we'll visit your location and, if the price works for you, we'll start right away.  The estimates are free and if you are not comfortable, there's no charge.
Please consolidate junk in the garage or accessible area. Let us know if you need help moving items from inside.
We confirm appointments to avoid wasted trips. Payment is due upon completion, preferably by credit or debit card.
Choose a suitable time for our truck to stop by.
